title: Tackling Bias in Pre-trained Language Models: Current Trends and Under-represented Societies
findings: The paper, a survey of existing literature, reports that Large Language Models like GPT-3 exhibit significant biases, such as a higher violent bias against Muslims compared to other religious groups. It also highlights that sentiment analysis models show significant sensitivity to religious identities, particularly in specific cultural contexts like India.
